g.text: Conditional grafting on a matched five-repeat backbone
Neutral phthalimide method control · SMD MeCN · 298.15 K
a: whiskers vary the rotor cutoff (25/50/100 cm⁻¹); they are not confidence intervals.
b: open markers graft j onto an empty backbone; filled markers graft j when i is occupied.
Nonadditivity includes conformation and solvent response; no occupancy distribution or electron-transfer rate.
